settings.about_content:
Allo Halal is a next-generation AI-powered Halal verification assistant designed for modern Muslim consumers. In an age of complex global food supply chains, identifying truly Halal products can be challenging. Our app combines advanced artificial intelligence with a massive global database to simplify this process.

Key Features:
• Advanced AI Analysis: We use the latest Llama 3 Vision and Text models from Groq AI to analyze ingredients in real time.
• Global Database: Access product data for over 3 million products worldwide through Open Food Facts.
• Multi-Language Support: Switch seamlessly between 9 major languages.
• Vision OCR: No barcode? Take a photo of the ingredient list and our AI will translate and analyze it instantly.
• Speed: Get results in milliseconds thanks to Groq's high-performance AI infrastructure.

Our mission is to empower Muslims globally with transparency, making Halal shopping faster, safer and 100% reliable.
settings.help_content:
Need help or have suggestions? The Allo Halal team is committed to giving you the best experience.

Common Support Topics:
• Reporting incorrect results: AI can sometimes make mistakes. If you see a wrong status for a product, please email us the barcode.
• Product not found: If a product is not in the database, you can use the 'Ingredient Scan' feature to manually analyze the label.
• Technical issues: If the app runs slowly, check your internet connection, as AI features require cloud processing.

Contact Us:
• Email: support@allohalal.fr
• Website: www.allohalal.fr
• FAQ: Visit our help center at allohalal.fr/faq

We typically respond to emails within 24–48 hours. Your feedback helps us improve Allo Halal for everyone!
settings.privacy_content:
At Allo Halal we believe your privacy is your right. We have designed this app with a 'Privacy-First' architecture.

Core pillars of privacy:
1. Data protection: Your personal information is kept secure and never sold to third parties.
2. Local data: Your scan history and saved products are stored on your device.
3. Secure AI: Images sent for analysis are processed through private APIs. No data is stored permanently.
4. Minimal permissions: We only need camera access for scanning.

Your trust is our greatest asset.

auth.terms_content:
Welcome to Allo Halal. By creating an account, you agree to these Terms of Service.

1. Purpose & Verification:
Allo Halal assists consumers in analyzing product ingredients and identifying halal or haram additives. While our database and AI models are continuously updated, consumers should verify with local halal certification bodies when in doubt.

2. Account Responsibility:
You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and for all actions conducted under your account.

3. Community Integrity:
Users agree not to exploit the service or submit false reviews.

Thank you for being part of the Allo Halal community.
